summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 10,000,000 Class A shares and 10,000,000 warrants to certain investors, sold under a September 17, 2026 securities purchase agreement, with the initial closing on September 18, 2026. Shares priced at $1.50 apiece, warrant exercise price $2.75, expiring one year from initial exercise. Investors hold a ten-day right to buy up to an aggregate $15,000,000 more on identical terms, capped at $1,000,000 daily per investor. A zero-price exercise floor of $0.5 could release up to 90,000,000 shares for no cash proceeds, creating significant dilution overhang; watch warrant exercise behavior and VWAP relative to the $2.75 strike.
